title: Revision-gated track deletion persistence
purpose: Close the track deletion concurrency gap by adding revision-gated compare-and-swap deletion to both canonical in-memory and D1 SeshTrackRepository implementations.

ordinaryDeleteCompatibility.implementation: Load current snapshot and delegate to deleteTrackConditionally.
ordinaryDeleteCompatibility.reason: Existing internal compensation callers remain compatible while all actual deletion becomes revision-gated.
